headline: Give risky controls a warning zone
subtext: The high-risk area is visually isolated from routine upkeep, giving recipient teams a pause point before permanent action.
image_alt_text: A Hush Line daily social graphic showing a desktop settings page where routine controls appear above a separate warning area for permanent account actions.

Routine upkeep belongs far from a warning zone.

In Hush Line, the high-risk area is visually isolated from everyday maintenance. For newsrooms, clinics, campus programs, and civic groups, that helps multiple collaborators notice they are near a serious action instead of another normal option.

The rule: ordinary tasks stay easy to reach; risky controls get unmistakable boundaries.

See Hush Line at https://hushline.app.
